Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is 基腿?

In this glossary, 基腿 refers to: The flight path at right angles to the landing runway off its approach end.

How is 基腿 used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "飞行员报告：'转向15号跑道的基腿，起落架放下。'"

Why does 基腿 matter in aviation?

基腿 matters because it supports clear communication in Basic ATC contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Who uses 基腿?

基腿 is mainly used by Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew.

What category does 基腿 belong to?

In this glossary, 基腿 is grouped under Basic ATC. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?
